top_signals.title: Houthi Advance Toward Bab el-Mandeb Raises New Shipping Threat
top_signals.summary: Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthi militants have seized control of the historic port city of Mocha, four government military sources said, ina strategic shift that could threaten the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, one of the world's most important shipping…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Asian Stocks, Bonds Drop on Oil, Inflation Concern: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks and bonds fell after a surge in oil prices sparked a selloff in US markets, while the latest inflation data reinforced bets on an imminent Federal Reserve interest-rate hike.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Xi’s First India Trip Since 2019 Extends an Olive Branch to Modi
top_signals.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping will visit India to attend the BRICS summit and likely meet with Prime Minister Narendra Modi on the sidelines. Bloomberg's Swati Pandey reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
